questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Under the Treaty of Versailles, Germany had to accept the blame for WWI. This was known as the…
questions.why: The War Guilt Clause forced Germany to accept blame — the humiliation that fed German anger for the next 20 years.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: Triangle: base 12 cm, height 5 cm. Area?
questions.why: ½ × base × height = ½ × 12 × 5 = 30. The 60 trap is forgetting the half.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: Lord of the Flies: who blows the conch to call the very first assembly?
questions.why: Piggy FINDS it and knows what it is — but Ralph blows it, and that's partly why the boys make him leader.

questions.subject: Commerce
questions.prompt: The section of a business plan that sums up the whole plan on one page is the…
questions.why: Executive summary = the whole plan in miniature, up front, for people who won't read the rest.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: In the MAIN causes of WWI, the M stands for…
questions.why: MAIN = Militarism, Alliances, Imperialism, Nationalism — the four pressures that primed Europe for war.

questions.subject: Science
questions.prompt: Which TWO particles sit inside the nucleus of an atom?
questions.why: Protons + neutrons pack the nucleus; electrons orbit outside it.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.why: Find the area of the end face, multiply by how long the prism runs. You've got this one — no rush needed.

questions.subject: Geography
questions.prompt: A family leaves their drought-ruined farm because Sydney has jobs. In migration terms, the drought and the jobs are…
options: Drought = push factor, jobs = pull factor
Drought = pull factor, jobs = push factor
questions.answer: Drought = push factor, jobs = pull factor
questions.why: Push DRIVES you out of where you are (drought at home). Pull DRAWS you toward somewhere new (jobs in Sydney). Out = push, in = pull.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.prompt: An L-shaped room is a 6 m × 4 m rectangle with a 2 m × 2 m square cut out of one corner. Floor area?
questions.why: Full rectangle 6 × 4 = 24, minus the missing 2 × 2 = 4. → 20 m². Build big, subtract the hole.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Put the chain in order: which of these came FIRST in the story of Hitler's rise?
options: WWI defeat and the Treaty of Versailles
questions.answer: WWI defeat and the Treaty of Versailles
questions.why: The chain you nailed on Friday: WWI defeat → Versailles humiliation → Depression desperation → Hitler's rise. It starts with the defeat.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: The boys let the signal fire go out because they'd rather hunt. Golding uses this to show…
options: Savagery winning over the hope of rescue
Keeping a fire alight was too difficult
Jack is a more practical leader than Ralph
The island was running out of firewood
questions.answer: Savagery winning over the hope of rescue
questions.why: The fire = the link to civilisation and rescue. Choosing the hunt over the fire is the island choosing savagery — and a ship passes while it's out.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: TEACHER MODE. A student wrote: "The boys stop using the conch because it got old and boring." Mark their answer: what did they miss? Explain what the conch really stood for — and why abandoning it matters by the end of the book.
